name: Thinking critically by metric
vision_statement: Everything the AI does for a person's goals is held to the metric that serves it, and what it says is held to what is known.
opportunities: A deep run can be held to the metric that serves its goal, and so can every other request, which is wider than the parent solution asks. That opens questions of its own: slicing the specification a task concerns before the run and writing back what the run learned, choosing the records an input concerns by lexical, vector and gated search, settling a narrow question with one guarded model call and a safe default, stopping unverified links and recognising repeated requests, telling a stuck run from a slow one, drafting a metric for a task that has none, and keeping background work to the days, hours and budget a person set.
solution_coherence: think-critically holds deep runs to their metric through iterate-by-spec on the records spec-selection picks, settles narrow questions through judge-a-decision, stops unsafe replies through guard-a-reply, ties work to its purpose through ground-in-intent, tells a stuck run from a slow one through detect-a-stalled-run, drafts a missing metric through draft-a-metric, and keeps background work inside its hours and budget through gate-an-autopilot-pass.
